help: 0.43.0 Usage: zinn task create [<project-key>] --title <text> [--description <text>|--description-file <path>] [--priority <priority>] [--due <timestamp>] [--label <name>]... [--column <name>] [--parent <task-key>] [--depends-on <task-key>]... [--duplicate-of <task-key>] [--related <task-key>]... Alias: zinn task new Create a task at the bottom of a column. Without --column, it starts in the project's first column. Omit the project key to use defaultProject from settings; otherwise a project key is required. Priority values: low, medium, high, urgent, none; defaults to none. --due accepts integer epoch milliseconds or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.SSS] with Z or a numeric offset such as +01:00. Fractional seconds have 1 to 3 digits. Use --due none to clear it. Omission leaves it unset on creation and unchanged on edit. Repeat --label to attach multiple existing labels. --description-file <path> takes the text from a UTF-8 file, or from stdin when <path> is "-". A value that begins with a dash must be joined to its flag with =, as in --description='- item'. The new task is a subtask of --parent, depends on --depends-on, is a duplicate of --duplicate-of, and is related to --related. Repeat --depends-on and --related to name several tasks. Each target may have one relation type. Identical repeated requests count once. Different relation types for the same target abort creation. Unknown columns, labels or related tasks abort creation. Examples: zinn task create MDR --title 'Refine the numbers' --description 'Meet the quarterly quota' --label urgent zinn task create MDR --title 'Review the numbers' --column 'In Progress' zinn task create MDR --title 'Sort the files' --parent MDR-1 --depends-on MDR-2 Usage: zinn reset --yes Browser extension for this playground format. Usage: zinn export [file] Browser extension for this playground format. Usage: zinn import <file> Browser extension for this playground format.
